name: JW Marriott Venice Resort & Spa
positioning: Resort on Isola delle Rose, a private island in Venice, set in 40 acres of gardens and olive groves, with a spa and several pools
best_for: Travelers who want a green island resort with a spa and pools in Venice
Families or groups wanting a residence or villa with a private pool

facts.text: The resort is set on Isola delle Rose, a private island in Venice.
The resort grounds cover 40 acres of gardens and olive groves.
Isola delle Rose was created in 1870 and is the youngest island in the Venetian lagoon.
For a hundred years, the island was home to a clinic.
Italian designer Matteo Thun worked with the island's existing buildings, protecting their 1920s character.
The JW rooms and suites are in the main building, while the JW Retreats are set in private gardens.
Villa Rose sleeps up to seven guests.
The resort has an indoor-outdoor heated Vitality Pool.
Guests can rent a private cabana at the Rooftop Pool or the Family Pool.
Sagra, the restaurant on the hotel's fourth floor, looks over the park and the Venetian lagoon.
Many of the vegetables and fruits on the menu are grown in the resort's JW Garden.
The Recreation Team arranges activities from volleyball to Venetian mask making.

highlights.text: Accommodation includes La Residenza with private pools, La Maisonette Suites with a plunge pool or garden, and the self-contained Villa Rose.
The rooftop pool has 360-degree views, and the family pool is surrounded by a century-old park.
The JW Venice Spa offers massage and beauty treatments, including a hair spa.
The resort handpicks, cold-presses and ages its own Isola delle Rose extra virgin olive oil from its olive grove.
Isola delle Rose has a refreshing microclimate where the lagoon meets the sea.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes that the island location requires water transportation for all city access.
The resort does not offer on-site parking.
